root_cause.text: An off-by-one error in the DMA error cleanup path of e1000/e1000e TX map functions, where `count` was decremented before the unmapping loop, causing one fewer DMA buffer to be unmapped than were successfully mapped, resulting in a DMA mapping leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch removes the lines `if (count) count--;` from the `dma_error` label in both `e1000_main.c` and `e1000e/netdev.c`, as these lines incorrectly reduced the count before the `while (count--)` unmap loop, as described in the commit message: "Because count is incremented after a successful mapping, it will always match the correct number of unmappings needed when dma_error is reached. Decrementing count before the while loop in dma_error causes an off-by-one error."
